notes: Re-ascension: when two lanterns of the same type are both ascended, merge one into the other to reach Ascended II, then Ascended III.
Each merge stacks ×1.75 damage, ×1.2 fire rate and ×1.12 range (Beacons get a stronger boost, Mints more gold).
Ascended II lanterns get a silver crown and a second ring. Ascended III lanterns glow in shifting colors.
